recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-8571. Handle any remaining PayeeType terminology changes through THO/UTG or a separately scoped reconciliation for FHIR-30929.
issue_request: FHIR-8571 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Financial Management change request raised against DSTU1 because the Payee Type value set page had an empty Definition column for its codes; Jira records the resolution as addressed in STU3.
initial_application: No commit explicitly references FHIR-8571. Source history shows commit 0d16fa6b9d38300d230738eb5a55c99646b78a5e added displays and definitions for the inline PayeeType concepts before STU3; later refactors moved the value set from inline ValueSet.codeSystem content to a compose include, and then to the THO canonical code system.
additional_context: The current core value set source includes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/payeetype. The current THO code system defines subscriber, provider, beneficiary, and other with non-empty definitions, and the current build value set expansion renders those definitions. Later related work such as FHIR-30929 and UP-246/UP-315 concerns broader THO PayeeType maintenance and does not require duplicating code definitions in core for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding concept definitions to source/terminologies/valueset-payeetype.xml would duplicate the external THO source of truth and is unnecessary because the current rendered value set already has the Definition column populated.

related_jiras.note: Same PayeeType terminology family, but it is Resolved - change required and broader than the missing-definition defect; it was not in this run's applied/published source-edit scope.
Later payee/provider clarification already has a combined-branch audit commit and does not affect whether PayeeType definitions are present.
UTG proposal corrected the external THO PayeeType display for the other code and the guarantor spelling.
UTG proposal updated external PayeeType terminology details and added beneficiary.
